evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: The assertive act of reproducing a prod failure pattern positions the speaker as one who diagnoses and validates against production authority — invoking a hierarchy where prod is the standard to match.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Directive modality enacts command — the speaker issues imperatives that allocate obligation to an unnamed implementer, a rank-based relational move.
